LPA.title: Northgate Helion SPV LP - Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership (Extract)

1.1:Affiliate.heading: Affiliate
1.1:Affiliate.text: "Affiliate" means, in relation to a person, any other person that directly or indirectly Controls, is Controlled by, or is under common Control with that person.

1.1:Beneficial Owner Limit.heading: Beneficial Owner Limit
1.1:Beneficial Owner Limit.text: "Beneficial Owner Limit" means 95 beneficial owners of the Partnership, measured immediately after giving effect to a proposed Transfer and as determined by the General Partner for the purposes of the Partnership's reliance on an exemption from registration under the Investment Company Act of 1940.

1.1:Business Day.heading: Business Day
1.1:Business Day.text: "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a day on which banks in New York City are authorized or required by law to close.

1.1:Capital Contribution.heading: Capital Contribution
1.1:Capital Contribution.text: "Capital Contribution" means, in relation to a Limited Partner, the amount contributed by it to the Partnership, as recorded in the Register.

1.1:Control.heading: Control
1.1:Control.text: "Control" means the power to direct the management and policies of a person, whether through ownership of voting securities, by contract or otherwise.

1.1:General Partner.heading: General Partner
1.1:General Partner.text: "General Partner" means Northgate Helion GP LLC.

1.1:Interest.heading: Interest
1.1:Interest.text: "Interest" means the entire interest of a Limited Partner in the Partnership, including its Capital Contribution and all rights attaching to it.

1.1:Permitted Transferee.heading: Permitted Transferee
1.1:Permitted Transferee.text: "Permitted Transferee" means, in relation to a Limited Partner: (a) an Affiliate of that Limited Partner; (b) a trust established solely for the benefit of that Limited Partner or members of that Limited Partner's immediate family; or (c) on the death of an individual Limited Partner, that Limited Partner's estate.

1.1:Portfolio Company Documents.heading: Portfolio Company Documents
1.1:Portfolio Company Documents.text: "Portfolio Company Documents" means the certificate of incorporation, bylaws and stockholders' agreement of the Portfolio Company, each as amended from time to time.

1.1:Register.heading: Register
1.1:Register.text: "Register" means the register of Limited Partners maintained by the General Partner.

1.1:Transfer.heading: Transfer
1.1:Transfer.text: "Transfer" means any direct or indirect sale, assignment, transfer, pledge, charge or other encumbrance of all or any part of an Interest, and includes any change of Control of a Limited Partner whose principal asset is its Interest.

1.1:Transfer and Adherence Agreement.heading: Transfer and Adherence Agreement
1.1:Transfer and Adherence Agreement.text: "Transfer and Adherence Agreement" means an agreement in the form approved by the General Partner under which a transferee agrees to be bound by this Agreement.

8.1.heading: 8.1 Restriction on Transfers
8.1.text: No Limited Partner may Transfer all or any part of its Interest without the prior written consent of the General Partner, which may be given or withheld in its sole discretion, except for a Transfer permitted under Section 8.2.

8.2.heading: 8.2 Permitted Transfers
8.2.text: A Limited Partner may Transfer all or part of its Interest to a Permitted Transferee without the consent of the General Partner, provided that (a) the Limited Partner gives the General Partner written notice of the proposed Transfer at least five clear Business Days before the Transfer is to take effect, excluding both the day on which the notice is received and the day on which the Transfer takes effect, and (b) the conditions in Section 8.4 are satisfied.

8.3.heading: 8.3 Minimum Holdings
8.3.text: Following any Transfer of part of an Interest, each of the transferor and the transferee must hold an Interest with a Capital Contribution of not less than US$10,000, unless the transferor is Transferring its entire Interest. For this purpose, the Capital Contribution attributable to the part Transferred is the transferor's Capital Contribution multiplied by the proportion of its Interest being Transferred, and the balance remains attributable to the transferor.

8.4.heading: 8.4 Conditions to Every Transfer

8.5.heading: 8.5 Effectiveness and Registration
8.5.text: A Transfer takes effect only when the General Partner records it in the Register. The General Partner shall not record a Transfer until each condition in this Article 8 has been satisfied, and the effective date of a Transfer may not be earlier than the date on which the last such condition is satisfied.

8.6.heading: 8.6 Transfers in Breach Void
8.6.text: Any purported Transfer made otherwise than in accordance with this Article 8 shall be void and shall not be recognized by the Partnership.

8.7.heading: 8.7 Costs
8.7.text: The transferor shall bear all costs and expenses incurred by the Partnership and the General Partner in connection with any Transfer.

8.8.heading: 8.8 Consents in Writing
8.8.text: Any consent of the General Partner under this Article 8 must be given in writing. Except as expressly provided in a side letter entered into in accordance with Section 12.4, no consent of the General Partner shall be deemed to have been given by reason of its failure to respond to a request.

12.4.heading: 12.4 Side Letters
12.4.text: The General Partner may enter into a side letter with a Limited Partner that varies the rights or obligations of that Limited Partner under this Agreement. As between the Partnership and that Limited Partner, the side letter shall prevail over this Agreement. Unless the side letter expressly provides otherwise, rights granted under it are personal to that Limited Partner and do not pass to any transferee.

14.2.heading: 14.2 Notices
14.2.text: Any notice or request to the General Partner under this Agreement must be delivered by email to notices@northgate-gp.example and is received on the day of transmission if sent before 5:00 p.m. New York time on a Business Day, and otherwise on the next Business Day.

8.4(a).heading: Transfer and Adherence Agreement
8.4(a).text: (a) the transferee has executed and delivered a Transfer and Adherence Agreement;

8.4(b).heading: KYC, AML and sanctions
8.4(b).text: (b) the transferee has completed the General Partner's investor onboarding procedures, including anti-money laundering and know-your-customer checks and sanctions screening, to the General Partner's satisfaction;

8.4(c).heading: Tax form
8.4(c).text: (c) the transferee has delivered a properly completed IRS Form W-9 or applicable Form W-8;

8.4(d).heading: Beneficial Owner Limit
8.4(d).text: (d) the Transfer would not cause the Partnership to exceed the Beneficial Owner Limit;

8.4(e).heading: Portfolio Company Documents
8.4(e).text: (e) the Transfer complies with the Portfolio Company Documents, to the extent they apply to it; and

8.4(f).heading: Accredited investor
8.4(f).text: (f) the transferee is an "accredited investor" as defined in Rule 501(a) of Regulation D.

SA.title: Helion Robotics, Inc. - Amended and Restated Stockholders' Agreement (Extract)

1.1:Affiliate.heading: Affiliate
1.1:Affiliate.text: "Affiliate" means, in relation to a person, any other person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that person.

1.1:Board.heading: Board
1.1:Board.text: "Board" means the board of directors of the Company.

1.1:Business Day.heading: Business Day
1.1:Business Day.text: "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a day on which banks in New York City are authorized or required by law to close.

1.1:Competitor.heading: Competitor
1.1:Competitor.text: "Competitor" means any person listed in Schedule 2, and any Affiliate of such a person.

1.1:Indirect Transfer.heading: Indirect Transfer
1.1:Indirect Transfer.text: "Indirect Transfer" means any Transfer of any direct or indirect interest in an Investment Vehicle, including any limited partnership interest, membership interest or economic participation in it, and includes any change of control of a person whose principal asset is such an interest.

1.1:Investment Vehicle.heading: Investment Vehicle
1.1:Investment Vehicle.text: "Investment Vehicle" means any Stockholder that is a partnership, company or other entity whose principal asset is Shares.

1.1:Permitted Transferee.heading: Permitted Transferee
1.1:Permitted Transferee.text: "Permitted Transferee" means, in relation to the transferor of an interest in an Investment Vehicle: (a) an Affiliate of that transferor; (b) a trust established solely for the benefit of that transferor or members of that transferor's immediate family; or (c) on the death of an individual transferor, that transferor's estate. For the avoidance of doubt, a fund or account managed or advised by the same investment adviser as the transferor is not a Permitted Transferee unless it is an Affiliate of the transferor.

1.1:Shares.heading: Shares
1.1:Shares.text: "Shares" means shares of any class of capital stock of the Company.

1.1:Transfer.heading: Transfer
1.1:Transfer.text: "Transfer" means any sale, assignment, transfer, pledge, charge or other encumbrance, whether direct or indirect.

1.1:Transfer Notice.heading: Transfer Notice
1.1:Transfer Notice.text: "Transfer Notice" means a written notice to the Company stating (a) the identity of the proposed transferee, (b) the interest proposed to be Transferred, (c) the price and other material terms, and (d) the proposed completion date.

3.1.heading: 3.1 Company Consent
3.1.text: No Stockholder shall Transfer any Shares, and no Investment Vehicle shall permit, register or give effect to any Indirect Transfer, without the prior written consent of the Company, approved by the Board.

3.2.heading: 3.2 Permitted Transferees
3.2.text: Section 3.1 does not apply to an Indirect Transfer to a Permitted Transferee, provided that the Investment Vehicle gives the Company written notice of the Indirect Transfer, identifying the transferee, at least ten clear Business Days before it takes effect, excluding both the day on which the notice is received and the day on which the Indirect Transfer takes effect.

3.3.heading: 3.3 Competitors
3.3.text: No Transfer or Indirect Transfer may be made to a Competitor, whether or not the Company has consented to it.

3.4.heading: 3.4 No Deemed Consent
3.4.text: The Company's failure to respond to any request for consent shall not constitute consent.

4.1.heading: 4.1 Right of First Refusal
4.1.text: Before any Indirect Transfer by way of sale, other than to a Permitted Transferee, the Investment Vehicle shall deliver a complete Transfer Notice to the Company, and the Company shall have the right to purchase the interest proposed to be Transferred on the terms set out in it.

4.2.heading: 4.2 Exercise Period
4.2.text: The Company may exercise its right by written notice given no later than the end of the twentieth Business Day after the day on which it receives a complete Transfer Notice. The period does not begin to run until a complete Transfer Notice has been received.

4.3.heading: 4.3 Whole, Not Part
4.3.text: The Company may exercise its right only in respect of the whole, and not part, of the interest set out in the Transfer Notice.

4.4.heading: 4.4 Waiver
4.4.text: The Company may waive its right under this Section 4 by written notice at any time.

4.5.heading: 4.5 Completion Window
4.5.text: If the Company waives its right or does not exercise it within the exercise period, the Indirect Transfer may be completed to the transferee named in the Transfer Notice, on terms no more favorable to that transferee, within 45 Business Days after the end of the exercise period or, if earlier, the date of the waiver. After that, a new Transfer Notice is required.

4.6.heading: 4.6 Rights Independent
4.6.text: The consent requirement in Section 3.1 and the right of first refusal in this Section 4 are independent. A waiver of the right of first refusal is not a consent under Section 3.1, and a consent under Section 3.1 is not a waiver of the right of first refusal.

6.1.heading: 6.1 Transfers in Breach Void
6.1.text: Any Transfer or Indirect Transfer made otherwise than in accordance with this Agreement shall be void. The Company shall not recognize any such Transfer or record it in its books, and each Investment Vehicle shall refuse to register, recognize or give effect to any such Indirect Transfer in its own records.

9.1.heading: 9.1 Notices
9.1.text: Any notice or request to the Company must be delivered by email to legal@helion-robotics.example and is received on the day of transmission if sent before 5:00 p.m. New York time on a Business Day, and otherwise on the next Business Day. The sender bears the burden of proving delivery.

SL.title: Side Letter - Northgate Helion GP LLC to Harbour Family Office LLC

1.heading: 1. Harbour Transferees
1.text: Notwithstanding Sections 8.1 and 8.2 of the LPA, Harbour may Transfer all or part of its Interest without the consent of the General Partner to (a) any Affiliate of Harbour, or (b) any fund or account managed or advised by Harbour Capital Advisers LLC (each, a "Harbour Transferee"), subject to the conditions in Section 8.4 of the LPA.

2.heading: 2. Deemed Consent
2.text: Where Harbour requests the General Partner's consent to any other Transfer, the General Partner shall respond within ten Business Days after receipt of a complete request. A request is complete if it identifies the proposed transferee, the part of the Interest to be Transferred, the price and the proposed completion date. If the General Partner does not respond within that period, its consent shall be deemed given at the end of that period.

3.heading: 3. Personal Rights
3.text: The rights in this letter are personal to Harbour. They do not pass to any transferee of Harbour's Interest and may not be relied on by any other Limited Partner.

4.heading: 4. No Effect on Other Obligations
4.text: Nothing in this letter affects (a) the conditions in Section 8.4 of the LPA, or (b) any obligation arising under the Portfolio Company Documents, which bind the Partnership and not the General Partner alone.

5.heading: 5. Governing Law
5.text: This letter is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
